#### === Annotation === ###
```{r}
all_markers <- markers
```

```{r}
### Ranking
top_markers <- all_markers %>%
  filter(
    p_val_adj  < 0.05,
    avg_log2FC > 0.5,
    pct.1      > 0.25,
    pct.2      < 0.50
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    specificity_score = pct.1 - pct.2,
    rank_score        = avg_log2FC * specificity_score
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(rank_score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

clusters <- sort(unique(top_markers$cluster))
cat("Clusters found:", paste(clusters, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
### Source 2: PanglaoDB
panglaodb_raw <- read.delim(
  "../markers/PanglaoDB_markers_27_Mar_2020.tsv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
panglaodb_human <- panglaodb_raw %>%
  filter(grepl("Hs", species)) %>%
  select(
    gene      = official.gene.symbol,
    cell_type = cell.type,
    organ     = organ,
    sens      = sensitivity_human,
    spec      = specificity_human
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "")

build_panglaodb_list <- function(db,
                                  organ_filter = c("Liver", "Immune system"),
                                  min_spec     = 0.0) {
  if (!is.null(organ_filter)) {
    db <- db %>% filter(organ %in% organ_filter)
  }
  if (min_spec > 0) {
    db <- db %>% filter(!is.na(spec), spec >= min_spec)
  }
  marker_list <- db %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(gene)), .groups = "drop")
  setNames(marker_list$genes, marker_list$cell_type)
}

# Adjust organ_filter 
panglao_list <- build_panglaodb_list(
  panglaodb_human,
  organ_filter = c("Liver", "Immune system"),
  min_spec     = 0.0
)
```

```{r}
save(panglao_list, file = "../results/panglao_list.RData")
```

```{r}
### Source 3: CellMarker 2.0
cellmarker_raw <- read_excel("../markers/Cell_marker_Human.xlsx")
```

```{r}
cellmarker_clean <- cellmarker_raw %>%
  filter(cell_type == "Normal cell") %>%
  select(tissue = tissue_type, cell_type = cell_name, gene = Symbol) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", gene != "NA") %>%
  mutate(gene = strsplit(gene, "[,;]+")) %>%
  unnest(gene) %>%
  mutate(gene = trimws(gene)) %>%
  filter(gene != "")

# Adjust tissue_filter "liver"
cellmarker_list <- build_cellmarker_list(
  cellmarker_clean,
  tissue_filter = "liver"
)
```

```{r}
save(cellmarker_list, file = "../results/cellmarker_list.RData")
```

```{r}
# functions.R
```

```{r}
#  Lấy kết quả Top 1 tốt nhất cho mỗi (cluster, source)
top1_results <- all_results %>%
  group_by(cluster, source) %>%
  mutate(
    tie_breaker = case_when(
      source %in% c("Canonical", "canonical_ref") ~ pct_ref_covered,
      source %in% c("CellMarker", "PanglaoDB") ~ pct_query_covered,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(jaccard_index), desc(tie_breaker)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%   ##slice_head(n=3), slice(1:3)
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-tie_breaker)

top1_results <- top1_results %>%
  filter(cell_type != "Unknown", jaccard_index > 0)
```

```{r}
#### Re-clustering
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

unknown_clusters <- comparison_df %>%
  filter(my_annotation == "Unknown") %>%
  pull(cluster)
  
unknown_obj <- subset(combined, idents = unknown_clusters)
```

```{r}
unknown_obj$old_clusters <- unknown_obj$seurat_clusters
unique(unknown_obj$old_clusters)

# Chuẩn hóa lại & Tìm Variable Features riêng cho nhóm Unknown
# Tính lại Variable Genes & ScaleData riêng
DefaultAssay(unknown_obj)
Layers(unknown_obj)

counts <- LayerData(
    unknown_obj,
    assay = "RNA",
    layer = "counts"
)
unknown_obj[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(
    counts = counts
)
Layers(unknown_obj[["RNA"]])

#split theo sample

unknown_obj[["RNA"]] <- split(unknown_obj[["RNA"]], f = unknown_obj$sample_id)
Layers(unknown_obj[["RNA"]])

unknown_obj <- NormalizeData(unknown_obj)
unknown_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(unknown_obj)
unknown_obj <- ScaleData(unknown_obj)
#
unknown_obj <- RunPCA(unknown_obj, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
# xem batch
DimPlot(unknown_obj, reduction = "pca", group.by = "orig.ident")

ElbowPlot(unknown_obj, ndims = 30)

```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 18 * 1024^3)

# RPCA Integration
unknown_obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = unknown_obj,
  method = RPCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  dims = 1:20,
  reference = 1,
  k.weight = 30,
  new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
unknown_obj <- JoinLayers(unknown_obj)
unknown_obj <- FindNeighbors(unknown_obj, dims = 1:20)
unknown_obj <- FindClusters(unknown_obj, resolution = 0.4)
unknown_obj <- RunUMAP(unknown_obj, dims = 1:20)

# 
DimPlot(unknown_obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
```

